snippet.title: Get Colossal Alpha Playtest trailer
snippet.description:
Alpha playtest incoming fast, Nov. 22-23!! Wishlist and sign up for the playtest here!! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2900240/Get_Colossal/

Giant robot 3rd person brawler/party game with huge unit size differences and inertia/physics based combat. Slug it out as tiny humans and giant robots in fully destructible environments! Team up with friends and prove your ultimate badassery. Get smacked! Get EVEN! Get EVEN BIGGER! GET COLOSSAL!

Music by the legendary Jonne "Purple Motion" Valtonen!! https://www.valtone.com/index_en.html

https://www.glitchhammer.games/
https://discord.gg/fsQgF9BNtx
